{{nutritionsummary|1 tablespoon (15 ml)|50|82|80|8.9 g|1 g|0 mg|9 mg|0.3 g|0 g|0.2 g|0.1 g|0%|0%|0%|0%}}

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic clove]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Vinegar|champagne vinegar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|freshly ground black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|extra virgin olive oil]]

==Procedure==

# Crush garlic clove with the side of the blade of a chef's knife or other flat object. Transfer the clove, leaving it in one piece, to a mixing bowl.
# Add the vinegar, pepper and salt, and allow to sit for 30 minutes.
# Remove and discard the garlic. [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] in the mustard. Slowly add the oil, whisking constantly to emulsify.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If not using immediately, store in a covered container in the refrigerator. Whisk again or shake container vigorously to re-emulsify before serving.
